entries.claim: Polymarket is a decentralised prediction market built on Polygon PoS.
It settles via the Gnosis Conditional Tokens Framework (CTF), using ERC-1155 outcome tokens.
Trading uses a hybrid central-limit order book: off-chain order matching with on-chain settlement.
Market resolution is delegated to the UMA Optimistic Oracle, with dispute escalation to the UMA DVM.
Trading has historically been zero-fee, with liquidity funded by maker incentives.
entries.source_ref: Published/reported fee + incentive materials; exact formula NOT asserted

entries.claim: In 2022 Polymarket settled with the US CFTC for operating an unregistered facility offering off-exchange event-based binary options, and subsequently geoblocked US users.
entries.source_ref: CFTC order/press (2022); penalty figure reported — verify order number on CFTC register

entries.claim: Polymarket was founded by Shayne Coplan.
Polymarket reportedly re-entered the US market via an acquired CFTC-licensed venue (2024-2025).
entries.source_ref: Press reporting — requires CFTC register verification of the acquired DCM

entries.claim: The Polymarket client delivery model and wallet/auth internals are not determinable without an artefact.
Polymarket contract addresses (CTF, CTF Exchange, collateral, UMA adapters) and any TVL/volume figures are not stated and require explorer + contract verification.
entries.source_ref: Requires PolygonScan + official registry verification; never to be fabricated

entries.claim: The order lifecycle (off-chain match -> on-chain settle -> UMA resolve -> redeem) is a synthesised model, not observed code.
